steps.text: Stay with your vehicle and do not panic.
steps.quote: If you should become stranded during a winter storm, stay with your vehicle and do not panic.

steps.text: Run the engine about ten minutes each hour, and keep a window slightly open while it runs.
steps.quote: Run the motor every hour for about ten minutes to maintain warmth, but keep windows open a little to prevent the buildup of carbon monoxide.

steps.text: Make sure the exhaust pipe is clear before running the engine.
steps.quote: Make sure the exhaust pipe is not blocked.

steps.text: Tie brightly colored cloth to a mirror, door handle, or external antenna so your car is visible.
steps.quote: Keep the car visible with brightly colored cloths tied to the side view mirrors, door handles, or external antenna.

steps.text: At night, turn on the dome light when the engine is running.
steps.quote: At night, turn on the dome light when running the engine.

steps.text: For an emergency needing police, fire, or ambulance help, call 911 immediately.
steps.quote: In an emergency, dial 911 from your phone immediately.

steps.text: If you cannot call, text 911 if your local center accepts texts.
steps.quote: Some PSAPs can now accept text-to-911

steps.text: Give your exact address or location as soon as possible, whether calling or texting.
steps.quote: provide a correct address or location as quickly as possible.

steps.text: Tell the call-taker what kind of emergency is happening.
Tell the call-taker the phone number you are calling from.
steps.quote: The phone number you are calling from

steps.text: Stay on the line until the call-taker tells you to hang up.
steps.quote: Do not hang up until the call-taker instructs you to do so.

steps.text: Use your phone as little as possible while the power is out.
steps.quote: If the power goes out save battery power by minimizing device use.

steps.text: Turn on low-power mode to help your battery last longer.
steps.quote: Change the settings on your phone to low power mode or place it on airplane mode to conserve energy.

steps.text: Lower screen brightness and disable apps you are not using.
steps.quote: dimming the brightness of your display screen and disabling certain applications.

steps.text: Keep calls brief and share only essential information.
steps.quote: If you do need to make a call, try to keep it brief and only convey vital information to emergency personnel and family.

steps.text: If the network is damaged and you see no signal bars, turn off your phone to stop it searching for a signal.
steps.quote: turning your phone off helps prevent the battery from draining as your phone seeks a usable wireless signal.
